title: Justified Evidence Collection for Argument-based AI Fairness Assurance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating dataset representativeness using Named Entity Recognition (NER) for country-specific terms, comparing fairness metrics (demographic parity, equalised odds, equal opportunity) across Global North and Global South subgroups, and conducting token-level counterfactual 'what-if' experiments by replacing regional terms (e.g., 'Europe' with 'Asia' or 'Africa') to observe shifts in sentiment predictions.
